label: Chakka
note: Strained dahi, so mesophilic lactococcal, not thermophilic yoghurt; Shrikhand is made from it

about.text: Indian yoghurt strained in muslin until it is thick and semi-solid. Sweetened and spiced with cardamom and saffron, it becomes shrikhand.

how.text: Chakka is dahi, soured by mesophilic lactococci, that has been hung in muslin until most of the whey has run off, leaving a semi-solid mass. Chakka is the base for sweetened shrikhand.

links.name: Rasane et al., J. Pure Appl. Microbiol. (2017)

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

microbes.name: Lactococcus lactis subsp. lactis biovar diacetylactis

steps.note: Hung in muslin overnight, industrially a basket centrifuge or quarg separator is used.
